_doc: What no player screen may show (openspec/changes/ui-art-direction design 12 to 14): internal names, debug values, placeholder names, dev tags and notes about how the game is built. The release check (crates/sc-client/src/release.rs, scripts/check.sh) lays out every reachable screen headless and fails on a text that holds one, naming the screen and the text. contains: a piece of text anywhere, as written; words: a whole word, as written (so PD is refused and SPEED is not); ip_address: four numbers with dots.
